description: This file defines the TimesheetPeriodSubscriber class, an event subscriber in the OrangeHRM system that intercepts HTTP requests related to timesheet periods. It determines whether to forward or restrict access based on configuration settings and request paths.

classes.name: TimesheetPeriodSubscriber
classes.description: Handles HTTP request events to determine access to timesheet functionality, possibly redirecting or forbidding access based on system configuration and request path.

methods.name: getSubscribedEvents
methods.description: Returns the list of events this subscriber listens to, specifically the request event with a priority of 100.

methods.name: onRequestEvent
methods.description: Processes incoming HTTP requests, checking the request path and configuration to decide whether to forward the request to the timesheet period controller, allow it, or throw exceptions to restrict access.
